infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MumDad Tracker uses the microphone to listen for the words "mum" and "dad" while tracking is switched on. Audio is not recorded or saved.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MumDad Tracker uses speech recognition to detect the words "mum" and "dad". Speech may be processed by Apple's speech recognition service; no audio is saved by the app.
